# effect-ui-extra v0.3.0

> Unified companion toolkit for @effect/ui: a11y (APG/RTL/names), page (zero-FOUC prefs/CSP/iOS guard/overlays/history/SSR), widgets (Command/Tree/Carousel/ImageCropper/Timeline/Waterfall), direct-manipulation/Kanban transfer, OKLCH/WCAG theme, spring/sheet/handoff motion, and shadcn-style copy-paste registry + CLI

Install pinned to a commit SHA: `github:MaxFabian25/effect-ui-extra#<sha>`.
Import by subpath so bundlers tree-shake unused modules.

## Subpath Exports

### `effect-ui-extra/a11y`

15 WAI-ARIA APG pattern verifiers, LTR/RTL direction checks, accessible-name checks, and zero-DOM TestHost focus tracking.

- **Values (9):** `auditPattern`, `checkPattern`, `auditDirection`, `checkDirection`, `AccessibleNameError`, `auditAccessibleNames`, `checkAccessibleNames`, `NAMABLE_ROLES`, `PatternViolationError`
- **Types (14):** `DirectionAuditResult`, `AccessibleNameViolation`, `CheckAccessibleNamesOptions`, `A11yDriver`, `A11yTarget`, `AnyHtmlPlay`, `ApgPattern`, `CheckPatternOptions`, `Direction`, `DomTarget`, `KeyModifiers`, `NodeLike`, `Orientation`, `PatternViolation`

### `effect-ui-extra/page`

Zero-FOUC SSR preferences and color scheme, CspContext nonce helpers, iOS modal touch jitter guard, Deferred-backed overlays, LiveAnnouncer, scoped ShortcutRegistry, checkServer SSR purity guard, semantic PageObserver/PageHistory with undoAgent(), InputModalityTracker, hidden="until-found" helpers, and theme-color dimming.

- **Values (64):** `browserStorageLayer`, `ColorScheme`, `colorSchemeFromHeaders`, `cookieStorageLayer`, `definePreference`, `makeMemoryStorage`, `memoryStorageLayer`, `preferencesScript`, `preferencesScriptBody`, `PreferenceStorage`, `resolveColorScheme`, `ConfirmOverlayEntry`, `makeOverlays`, `OverlayEntry`, `OverlayHost`, `Overlays`, `overlaysLayer`, `PromptOverlayEntry`, `ResolveOverlay`, `Announcement`, `LiveAnnouncer`, `liveAnnouncerLayer`, `LiveRegion`, `makeLiveAnnouncer`, `Politeness`, `ariaKeyshortcuts`, `createShortcutTable`, `formatShortcut`, `makeShortcutRegistry`, `ShortcutRegistry`, `shortcutRegistryLayer`, `auditServer`, `checkServer`, `ServerPurityError`, `makePageObserver`, `PageObserver`, `pageObserverLayer`, `REDACTED_PLACEHOLDER`, `makePageHistory`, `PageHistory`, `pageHistoryLayer`, `inputModalityLayer`, `InputModalityTracker`, `makeInputModality`, `modalityFromKey`, `modalityFromPointer`, `resolvePointerKind`, `bindBeforeMatch`, `chunkFindableRows`, `panelHiddenAttr`, `supportsHiddenUntilFound`, `blendThemeColor`, `createThemeColorDimmer`, `CspContext`, `cspLayer`, `cspScriptTag`, `cspStyleTag`, `getCspConfig`, `getCspNonce`, `preferencesScriptWithCsp`, `bindIosModalTouchGuard`, `initialIosTouchGuardState`, `reduceIosTouchGuard`, `resolveInteractiveTapTarget`
- **Types (45):** `ColorSchemeValue`, `MemoryStorageHandle`, `Preference`, `PreferenceSpec`, `PreferenceStorageService`, `StorageChange`, `StorageKind`, `SystemColorScheme`, `ConfirmOptions`, `OverlayResult`, `OverlaysService`, `PromptOptions`, `LiveAnnouncerService`, `DocumentedShortcut`, `ShortcutBinding`, `ShortcutConflict`, `ShortcutMetadata`, `ShortcutPlatform`, `ShortcutRegistryService`, `CheckServerOptions`, `ServerPurityViolation`, `ChangeSource`, `ObservedChange`, `PageObserverService`, `RecordChangeInput`, `RestoreHandler`, `HistoryActionResult`, `HistoryEntry`, `HistorySnapshot`, `PageHistoryOptions`, `PageHistoryService`, `UndoSourceResult`, `InputModality`, `InputModalityService`, `ModalityState`, `PointerKind`, `FindableStandInGroup`, `PanelHiddenOptions`, `ThemeColorDimmer`, `CspConfig`, `IosTouchGuardConfig`, `IosTouchGuardDecision`, `IosTouchGuardEvent`, `IosTouchGuardState`, `TouchPoint`

### `effect-ui-extra/widgets`

Headless application widgets and AI-chat controls complementing @effect/ui-kit (Command, Tree, Resizable, Listbox, PasswordInput, TimeInput, TokenInput, Pagination, SegmentedControl, InlineEdit, Rating, ColorPicker, Carousel, ImageCropper, Timeline, Waterfall, StickToBottom, TriggerMenu, InputHistory, inputHints, TreeChecked, AsyncOptions).

### `effect-ui-extra/direct`

Pure 2D spatial/grid focus, CellRange and lasso selection, SwipeActions, TestClock-driven holdEffect/repeatStream, cycle-safe TreeReorder, cross-container Kanban transfer, infinite canvas Viewport/Connect, quadratic edge AutoScroll, and TimeSpan math.

- **Values (35):** `moveGridFocus`, `nearestInDirection`, `cellsInRange`, `computeLassoSelection`, `isCellInRange`, `normalizeCellRange`, `rectFromPoints`, `rectsIntersect`, `evaluateSwipeDrag`, `handleSwipeKey`, `resolveSwipeRelease`, `rubberBand`, `holdEffect`, `repeatStream`, `canMoveTreeNode`, `moveTreeNode`, `canConnectPorts`, `canvasToScreen`, `findSnapPort`, `fitBounds`, `nextPortInDirection`, `panViewport`, `screenToCanvas`, `viewportTransformCss`, `zoomAtPoint`, `computeAutoScroll`, `detectSpanOverlaps`, `moveTimeSpan`, `resizeTimeSpanEnd`, `resizeTimeSpanStart`, `snapTimeValue`, `canTransferItem`, `findTransferItem`, `moveTransferItemByKey`, `transferItem`

### `effect-ui-extra/theme`

OKLCH/sRGB/Display-P3 color engine, hue-preserving gamut clamping, WCAG 2.1 and APCA contrast auditing, theme CSS generation, and opt-in @layer effect-ui stylesheet (effect-ui-extra/theme/effect-ui.css).

- **Values (28):** `SCALE_STEPS`, `srgbToLinear`, `linearToSrgb`, `oklchToLinearSrgb`, `isInSrgbGamut`, `oklchToLinearP3`, `isInP3Gamut`, `clampToGamut`, `oklchToSrgb`, `srgbToOklch`, `parseColor`, `formatOklch`, `formatHex`, `mixOklch`, `generateScale`, `relativeLuminance`, `compositeOver`, `wcagContrast`, `meetsWcagAA`, `meetsWcagAAA`, `meetsUiControlContrast`, `apcaContrast`, `auditThemeContrast`, `TOKEN_CSS_NAMES`, `DEFAULT_LIGHT_TOKENS`, `DEFAULT_DARK_TOKENS`, `themeContrastPairs`, `generateThemeCss`
- **Types (6):** `OklchColor`, `SrgbColor`, `ScaleStep`, `ContrastPair`, `ContrastFailure`, `ThemeTokens`

### `effect-ui-extra/motion`

Closed-form analytical springs, compositor CSS linear() easing, pointer velocity tracker, momentum projection, rubber-band overscroll, snap points, draggable sheet reducer, scroll-to-drag handoff, Presence lifecycle, and Carousel reducer.

- **Values (22):** `settleTime`, `solveSpring`, `springLinearEasing`, `createVelocityTracker`, `findSnapIndex`, `nearestIndex`, `projectDistance`, `resolveSnapPoints`, `rubberBand`, `initialSheetState`, `reduceSheet`, `sheetBackdropProgress`, `initialPresenceState`, `reducePresence`, `carouselPageCount`, `initialCarouselState`, `isCarouselAutoplayActive`, `reduceCarousel`, `initialScrollHandoffState`, `isAtScrollBottom`, `isAtScrollTop`, `reduceScrollHandoff`
- **Types (22):** `SpringConfig`, `SpringCssEasing`, `SpringSample`, `SnapPoint`, `VelocitySample`, `VelocityTracker`, `SheetConfig`, `SheetEvent`, `SheetPhase`, `SheetState`, `PresenceEvent`, `PresencePhase`, `PresenceState`, `CarouselConfig`, `CarouselEvent`, `CarouselState`, `ScrollBoundary`, `ScrollHandoffEdge`, `ScrollHandoffEvent`, `ScrollHandoffMode`, `ScrollHandoffState`, `ScrollHandoffTransition`

### `effect-ui-extra/registry`

shadcn-style copy-paste styled component registry, 5 WCAG-audited OKLCH visual presets (nova, vega, maia, lyra, mira), 27 Tailwind v4 + Effect UI app/AI blueprints and page blocks, and the effect-ui CLI (init, list, view, add, diff, preset).

- **Values (27):** `decodePresetName`, `decodeProjectUiConfig`, `DEFAULT_UI_CONFIG`, `encodeProjectUiConfig`, `IconPackSchema`, `PresetNameSchema`, `ProjectUiConfigSchema`, `RegistryCategorySchema`, `RegistryFileSchema`, `RegistryItemSchema`, `generatePresetCss`, `getVisualPreset`, `listVisualPresets`, `VISUAL_PRESETS`, `diffRegistryContent`, `getRegistryItem`, `listRegistryItems`, `REGISTRY_ITEMS`, `resolveRegistryTree`, `CONFIG_FILENAME`, `readProjectUiConfig`, `runAdd`, `runCli`, `runDiff`, `runInit`, `runPreset`, `writeProjectUiConfig`
- **Types (12):** `IconPack`, `PresetName`, `ProjectUiConfig`, `RegistryCategory`, `RegistryFile`, `RegistryItem`, `VisualPreset`, `FileDiffSummary`, `ResolvedRegistryPlan`, `AddResult`, `CliResult`, `InitResult`

### `effect-ui-extra/theme/effect-ui.css`

Optional `@layer effect-ui` default stylesheet with native `light-dark()` OKLCH tokens, `[data-color-scheme="light"|"dark"]` overrides for `effect-ui-extra/page`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `forced-colors`, and zero CSS `content:` icon hacks.

### `effect-ui-extra` (root namespace export)

Re-exports `A11y`, `Direct`, `Motion`, `Page`, `Registry`, `Theme`, and `Widgets` namespaces.
